environment: Cloud Chromium 156, SwiftShader software WebGL, 1440x900, parallel development workload; diagnostic only, not Pleos GPU performance

provenance.capture: Isolated React world harness with seeded or complete eight-site Seoul scene; application panels excluded.
provenance.instrumentation: Scratch Playwright initialization counted WebGL draw calls and requestAnimationFrame intervals. No production debug globals were added.
provenance.baseline: The same Seoul world before repeated road markings and shop roof ribs were instanced.
provenance.optimized: Road and roof batching, same keepsake geometry placement and materials; static collection-shadow invalidation enabled.
limitations: SwiftShader software WebGL under a contended parallel cloud workload; not official Pleos runtime or GPU evidence.
Animation-frame intervals measure the browser event loop plus rendering workload and do not isolate GPU execution time.
The small sample sets are diagnostics, not a stable frame-rate benchmark or head-unit acceptance budget.
Counts include main and shadow rendering work; ordinary frames and frames that update shadows differ.
No CPU, GPU, memory, thermal, long-session or physical-display automotive certification is established.
